prompt: Draft an email to a small bookshop asking whether it could host a reading by three local writers. Mention that the group can provide its own chairs if needed and is flexible about dates. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: Reading Event with Three Local Writers

Dear [Bookshop Name] team,

I’m writing on behalf of three local writers to ask whether you might be interested in hosting a reading at your shop. We’d love to share selections from our work in a welcoming setting and connect with readers in the community.

We imagine a relaxed event with short readings from each writer, followed by time for questions and conversation. We’re flexible about dates and happy to work around your schedule. We can also provide our own chairs if extra seating would be helpful.

Would this be something you’d consider? We’d be glad to send brief writer biographies and discuss any practical details.

Best wishes,
[Your Name]
